research_rationale: EO 12200 of March 12, 1980 (45 FR 16443, March 14, 1980) adjusts the pay-schedule order EO 12165: it adds footnotes on appropriations limits, substitutes revised Schedules 1 through 7, corrects one statutory reference, and adds Schedule 8 (judicial salaries). Executive Order 12248 of October 16, 1980 (45 FR 69199, October 20, 1980), sec. 1-202, provides in the held Federal Register text layer: "Executive O rders No. 12165 of October 12,1979 and"; line break; "No. 12200 of M arch 12,1980 are superseded." Every clause of 12200 is a pay-rate or schedule command that 12248 replaces with new schedules for the same pay systems, so the whole order ended by express supersession. The Office of the Federal Register catalog note held in the status history also records "Superseded by: EO 12248, October 16, 1980". The recorded first end is the 1980-10-16 date of the superseding order; 12248 sec. 1-201 made the new rates effective October 1, 1980 for the uniformed services and from the first applicable pay period beginning on or after October 1, 1980 for other pay, so the replaced rates stopped operating up to about two weeks before the signing date; a reviewer should note this earlier effective reading. 12248 recites 12165 as "of October 12, 1979" whereas 12200 gives October 9, 1979; the order number and the date March 12, 1980 identify 12200 unambiguously. The APP transcription of 12248 reads the same: Executive Orders No. 12165 of October 12, 1979 and No. 12200 of March 12, 1980 are superseded.
savings_reason: Pay already earned at the 12200 rates before the 12248 rates took effect accrued to the employees and members; 12248 sec. 1-201 makes the other pay adjustments effective on the first day of the first applicable pay period "beginning on or after O ctober 1,1980." so the later rates replaced the earlier ones from that date and no 12200 command continues.
earlier_end_check: Searched the held corpus for the order number: only EO 12248 (sec. 1-202) names EO 12200; the OFR catalog note lists the single disposition "Superseded by: EO 12248, October 16, 1980"; the 1989 OFR codification row also reads "Supersededby EO 12248"; no earlier revocation, expiry or own-term end appears in the text (the schedule notes only say rates are subject to further adjustment by the Congress).
scope_check: 12248 supersedes the order as a whole (sec. 1-202 names EO 12200 without limiting words), and sec. 1-101 to 1-103 reissue Schedules 1-7 and 8 for every pay system 12200 covered, so no part of 12200 survives as a separate command; the partial amendment of 12165 by 12200 is not a separate surviving command since 12165 is superseded in the same sentence.
independent_command_check: 12200 contains no independent standing command apart from the pay schedules and the footnotes, reference correction and Schedule 8 attached to them; each is tied to the schedules of EO 12165, which 12248 also supersedes; the statutory notes at 28 U.S.C. 153 note and 5 U.S.C. 5332 note only recite 12200 historically and do not continue it.
savings_check: Savings: pay already earned at the 12200 rates before the 12248 rates took effect accrued; no continuing 12200 command or residual right to future payment under its schedules was found, and 12248 sec. 1-201 and 1-202 replace the rates and supersede the order. Searched the held corpus by order number; only 12248 names 12200.
